name: @red-cup-engineering/wire-form-round-trip-check
description: Checks that a declared reading (a named toWire/fromWire pair between one EAVT witness row, or an ordered log of them, and some wire form) round-trips losslessly, and that two readings agree when hopped through a shared witness pivot. Generic wire-boundary round-trip checking with no witness-journal domain law of its own — extracted from relating's ledger, where it was fused with the journal-specific coherence judgement built on top of it.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm test
